problem: After four actual result groups, accepted APK preparation counts advanced while the board could still show an older public progress snapshot.
observed_failure: The outer coordinator had to refresh the board manually after the 111/109/21 display lagged the authoritative 114/114/23 counts. The checked-in historical board at HEAD was older still (100/98/16); neither board state is evidence of current runtime startup.
discarded_action: Treat successful publication or the board's own heartbeat as proof that its progress agrees with the root-accepted task summary.
one_improvement: Before a board snapshot is called current, compare accepted raw/static/qualified/startup counters from TASK-SUMMARY.json to OUTER-STATE.json progress and projected kanban-state.json progress, require matching board/outer snapshot and checked_at fields, and require outer checked_at not earlier than summary checked_at. Fail closed with a field-level mismatch list.
causal_chain: Manual summary-to-board refresh and stale displayed counters -> no content-level cross-hop check -> read-only three-hop counter/timestamp gate -> avoid rechecking a falsely current board or reporting stale progress -> current inputs GO rc0, deliberately stale 111/109/21 counterexample NO_GO rc2.
trigger_result_groups: FluffyChat exact raw/static root scope admission
imo official raw/static/blackbox root scope admission
applicability: OH7/AOSP16 ARM64 Bionic outer control projection only. Counts remain preparation classes; 0/200 startups and 0/89 Bionic whole tools are unchanged by this pilot.
known_limits: This is a local file projection check; it does not prove a remote board was published or viewed.
Matching counters cannot prove individual APK receipt identity or a correct source ledger.
The 111/109/21 counterexample is generated in memory; it does not overwrite the current board.
next_evidence: Independently replay a production publisher dry-run on a frozen new acceptance and an unchanged snapshot, then verify remote served board bytes/etag against the approved projection; add receipt-set digest to the projection before claiming content identity.
promotion_gate: Independent review of receipt-to-summary provenance and safe public field projection, positive unchanged case, negative stale-counter and same-count-different-receipt cases, plus remote served-byte check. Keep the pilot outside production until these pass.
rollback: Keep manual evidence-gated board review if the gate gives false freshness, leaks private paths or device IDs, or blocks an unchanged valid snapshot.
